bibl.title: A Possible Monastery and the 'Upper Maqs' at Ukma-Akasha West?
bibl.seg: David N. Edwards, A Possible Monastery and the 'Upper Maqs' at Ukma-Akasha West?
bibl.note: Studies enclosed medieval settlements in the area of Akasha and Ukma West, excavated in 1969 by the Archaeological Survey of Sudanese Nubia. - Akasha West [21-N-11]. - The Church [where inscribed plaster fragments were found]. - Finds [including a parchment in Coptic, sherds with incised graffiti and an Old Nubian ostracon; edd.: Vincent W.J. van Gerven Oei & Adam Łajtar, Two Old Nubian Inscriptions from Akasha West, EtTrav 32 (2019) pp. 89-97, figg.]. - The wider context. - Some conclusions.
